predictions: My second 16-9 record in the last two weeks tied for my third worst week of the season. As per usual, I had 5 of 9 incorrect picks that would have flipped or tied on a single dart. And also as per usual, I got exactly zero C division winners correct last week. I am a stunning 11-18 in C division matches this season… I don't have divisional w/l records in an easy-to-pull-up format, but I would hazard a guess that this is not only my worst division ever, but it's the worst by a decent margin. Anyway, I'm at 168-80 (67.7% correct) for the season so far.

Match of the week: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Dart Knights. The Knights got the big win in the season's best race last week, outlasting The Dartifacts and leaving only tonight's opponent sitting one match ahead of the rest of the leader quartet. Obviously, that makes this pair this week's match of the century! The Knights handled the Dartness with little issue 7 weeks ago, but that almost never happens, so don't expect any walkover here. I'm taking the Knights again, but only 13-11.

Match #2: (E Div.) Banging The Wire @ Rippin Darts. Dirty Darts is long gone, but it's likely that somebody is headed up to D with them next season. Bangin has been looking up at Rippin all season after their horrid first-two-weeks start. But Bangin has now won 6 of their last 8, with double-digit points in even their two losses as well. How do I pick against that kind of super hot run? Well… I don't. 14-10.

Match #3: (G Div.) The Dartifacts @ I Got Your 6. All that stuff in the match of the week above? Here are the other two in the quartet, in this week's 'near'-match-of-the-century. When in doubt, I find the "go with the best cricket team in the division" strategy to be sound. Your 6, 14-10.

Match #4: (B Div.) Kilts In The Hall @ Consistently Inconsistent. Inconsistent has a point lead here, so this isn't directly a head-to-head for 2nd place, but it's close. Last week, the Inconsistent guys gave me crap because I picked them to win, but not by enough. We'll go with CI here, 23-1. If they win by less, they failed to live up to expectations.

Match #5: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Menace 2 Sobriety. With the Rangers facing the undefeated top team tonight, Menace could pull within a flippin' whisker of 2nd place with a win tonight. And somehow, #2 Rif Raf hasn't surpassed 13 points since week 2, so they just feel ripe for the picking, don't they? I'm going with the Menace upset, 13-11.

Matches #6 & #7: (C Div.) Village Idiots @ One Armed Bandits; Darty Sanchez @ Nine Lives. Teams #2 through #6 in the 7-team C division are separated by only a total of 2 wins and 23 points. Just about any of these teams can still finish 2nd (and climb to B?) or next to last (and fall to D?). Four of those square off in a pair of matches here. The Bandits are CRAZY unpredictable, and I'll take them, 13-11; and sure, let's say the Niners get some payback, 13-11.
Match #8: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Armed & Hammered. The Ducks are only 3-3 in the last six weeks, so the chase for 2nd might still be on. Superb matchup, but I think She Said get it, 13-11.

Match #9: (B Div.) Put It On Sam's Brother's @ Shooter McGavin. Only two winless teams left in the league this season. Is this Sam's Brother's last real shot? Maybe. It'll be close, but McGavin, 14-10.

Match #10: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Mulligan's Mafia. That nutso story listed in matches #6/7? Well, the last place team is only half a match farther back. Mafia, with little conviction. 13-11.
Match #11: (E Div.) Death Throw @ Cheap Shots. Is the winner in the discussion for the race for 2nd? Is the loser worried about dropping to F? Sort of a sneaky important match. Cheapies in 1001.
Match #12: (G Div.) Triple Shot @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. Kinda looking like the winner of this one will be able to escape any role in the storyline about 'that' finishing spot. We Throw It, 14-10.
And the remaining 13 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Brave the Elements 18, Why So Serious? 6; Lunatic Fringe 15, Talladega Flights 9; Dart Attack 17, Stumble Out 7.
B Division: Darty Minds 16, Raging Bulls Eyes 8.
D Division: Wing & A Plaque 14, Red-eye Rangers 10; Irish Ton 13, Ton 80 Proof 11; Liquor Possee 12+, Dart Side 12.
E Division: Corks 13, Machine 11; Dirty Darts 19, She-nanigans 5.
F Division: Duck Duck Groove 14, Sofa Kings 10; Shark Shooters 14, Nein Mark 10; Bottoms Up 16, Coach's Into Enya 8.
G Division: 21 Dart Salute 15, Bright side of Flights 9.
